title: A Orbit for the Protocol
author: Astrid Coldharbour
blurb: Noor Lockridge, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
